data.title: 久岛鸥 · 海风码头上的皮箱少女
data.description: 海轮离港的汽笛声还在回荡。鸥坐在巨大的皮箱上，双腿悬空轻快地晃悠着。她展开手中折痕累累的藏宝图，单手按住被风吹乱的双马尾，回眸发出灿烂的邀请。
data.location: sunny weathered wooden pier overlooking sparkling island harbor and white ferry
data.action: sitting perched atop large brown leather vintage trunk, legs swinging, holding weathered parchment map and smiling cheerfully
data.lighting: brilliant maritime morning sun with blue ocean sparkles and sea gulls soaring
data.mood: adventurous fairy-tale youth, whimsical seaside charm, delightful bright companionship
data.promptProse: Sitting on an antique leather trunk on the wooden dock, lavender-haired Kamome holds a treasure map and beams with infectious joyful energy.
data.animaCaption: Kamome Kushima sitting on her trunk at the pier with a treasure map in hand.
